exposure_anchors.1: Negligible AML/CFT exposure: domestic-only, low-value, fully cashless, no PEP/high-risk customers, no third-party flows.
exposure_anchors.2: Limited exposure: small-value, mostly domestic, occasional international, no obvious high-risk customer types.
exposure_anchors.3: Moderate exposure: cross-border activity, some PEP / high-risk jurisdictions in the customer base, occasional cash, third-party payments.
exposure_anchors.4: High exposure: significant cross-border activity, regular PEP / high-risk-jurisdiction touchpoints, complex ownership counterparties, third-party flows, virtual-asset interfaces.
exposure_anchors.5: Severe exposure: AMLR-obliged entity at scale (bank, CASP, payment institution), high-volume cross-border flows, large PEP book, multi-product complexity, correspondent / nested relationships.

threat_credibility_anchors.1: Theoretical: no credible TF/ML threat actors known to target this profile; jurisdiction not on FATF / EU lists.
threat_credibility_anchors.2: Documented but rare: domestic typology, infrequent and well-contained.
threat_credibility_anchors.3: Documented and current: typology actively used by criminal groups in the operating jurisdiction; recent regulator alerts.
threat_credibility_anchors.4: Active and adapted: typology in active use; criminals adapt to controls; FIU bulletins reference the entity's sector.
threat_credibility_anchors.5: Active and targeted: the entity has evidence (alerts, prior incidents) of being directly targeted by AML/TF networks.

vulnerability_anchors.1: Programme essentially complete: documented + tested + audited; minor improvement items only.
vulnerability_anchors.2: Programme largely in place: small gaps, recent independent review.
vulnerability_anchors.3: Programme partial: key controls present but with documented exceptions / stale evidence / training gaps.
vulnerability_anchors.4: Programme weak: multiple controls absent or untested; no recent independent review; staff coverage thin.
vulnerability_anchors.5: Programme absent: no documented CDD / TM / screening / STR pathway; or documented but not operating.
